headings.title: Creation of department and director appointment
headings.reviewNote: Creates the department of social services under a director appointed by the governor and transfers prior public health and welfare functions.

headings.title: Legislative intent and department responsibilities
headings.reviewNote: Details the general assembly's intent for the department to coordinate programs assisting vulnerable persons and addressing root causes of disadvantage.

headings.title: Construction of references to division of welfare
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that statutory references to the division of welfare mean the department of social services or its appropriate division.

headings.title: Transfer of Office of Economic Opportunity responsibilities
headings.reviewNote: Transfers state responsibilities under federal Public Law 452 regarding the Office of Economic Opportunity to the department of social services.

headings.title: Transfer of crippled children's services
headings.reviewNote: Transfers powers, duties, and functions concerning crippled children's services from the curators of the University of Missouri to the department.

headings.title: Transfer to youth services and advisory board
headings.reviewNote: Transfers board of training schools powers to the division of youth services and reconstitutes the board as an advisory body.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.010 covering department creation, legislative intent, statutory reference construction, and program transfers.

headings.title: Establishment and funding of administrative trust fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs the state treasurer to establish the Department of Social Services Administrative Trust Fund funded by annual appropriations and deposits.

headings.title: Contents and sources of trust fund moneys
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that the fund contains moneys transferred or paid to the department for goods and services provided to governmental entities or the public.

headings.title: Approval and disbursement of trust fund moneys
headings.reviewNote: Requires commissioner of administration approval for disbursements from the fund upon request by the department director or designee.

headings.title: Nonlapse of fund balance and year-end limitations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits unencumbered balances in the fund from lapsing to general revenue except amounts exceeding one-twelfth of annual receipts.

headings.title: Annual report of fund receipts and disbursements
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department director to prepare an annual report accounting for all receipts and disbursements from the administrative trust fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.012 covering administrative trust fund establishment, deposits, disbursements, nonlapse terms, and reporting.

headings.title: Mandatory telephone tracking system for in-home providers
headings.reviewNote: Requires in-home provider agencies to maintain a telephone tracking system by July 1, 2015, and establishes minimum verification criteria.

headings.title: System usage for payroll and reimbursement claims
headings.reviewNote: Requires telephone tracking systems to be used for employee payroll processing and reimbursement claim submissions to MO HealthNet.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and statutory nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department of health and senior services to promulgate minimum criteria by rule subject to chapter 536, section 536.028 if applicable, and nonseverability for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2010.

headings.title: Authorization for advanced tracking technology
headings.reviewNote: Permits the department to allow use of a more advanced tracking system at least as capable as subsection 1; source footnote notes "advance" appears in original rolls.

headings.title: Regional pilot projects and reporting to general assembly
headings.reviewNote: Directs implementation of urban and rural pilot projects and requires a reporting evaluation to the governor and general assembly by December 31, 2013.

headings.title: Inclusion of minority report upon substantial dissent
headings.reviewNote: Requires inclusion of a minority report detailing dissenting views if consensus between providers and executive officials is not reached.

headings.title: Prohibition on mandatory vendor contracting or cost burdens
headings.reviewNote: Protects interested parties and in-home providers from being required to contract with specific vendors or bear full pilot costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.023 covering telephony tracking requirements, payroll usage, rulemaking, pilot projects, and vendor protections.

headings.title: Certification of authorization requirement for provider agreements
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits MO HealthNet provider agreements for intermediate care facilities without department of mental health certification, excepting six-bed homes.

headings.title: Advance notice required for operating additional beds
headings.reviewNote: Requires prospective intermediate care providers seeking bed capacity beyond May 1991 levels to give advance notice between July and October.

headings.title: Grounds for certificate refusal and provider agreement denial
headings.reviewNote: Directs refusal of certificates and provider agreements when services can be accommodated within the home and community-based waiver.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.075 covering intermediate care facility certification requirements, expansion notice, and refusal grounds.

headings.title: Additional appropriations for elderly nutrition services
headings.reviewNote: Permits additional annual legislative appropriations for nutrition services for the elderly, allocated to the department of health and senior services for equitable distribution to area agencies on aging.

headings.title: Additional transportation appropriations for elderly and disabled
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes additional annual funding for elderly and disabled transportation distributed equitably through area agencies on aging.

headings.title: Additional appropriations for home-delivered meals
headings.reviewNote: Permits additional appropriations for senior home-delivered meals distributed to area agencies on aging according to departmental formulas.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.099 covering supplemental appropriations for area agencies on aging, transportation, and home-delivered meals.

headings.title: Establishment of Utilicare heating and cooling assistance plan
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department of social services to establish the Utilicare plan providing heating and cooling assistance to qualifying households.

headings.title: Definitions of eligible households and income thresholds
headings.reviewNote: Defines elderly, disabled, and qualified individual households based on age, disability benefits, and federal poverty or state median income levels.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.100 establishing the Utilicare financial assistance plan and defining qualifying household categories.

headings.title: Payment limits and disbursements to utility suppliers
headings.reviewNote: Permits paying up to eight hundred dollars per fiscal year for heating suppliers and up to eight hundred dollars for cooling suppliers from the utilicare stabilization fund while substantially maintaining prior respective shares.

headings.title: Direct payment limits for renting households
headings.reviewNote: Requires direct Utilicare payments to renting heads of household (excluding publicly owned/subsidized housing and specified care facilities) capped at eight percent of annual rent or $100, whichever is less; Revisor's Note states "residential care facility" may include "assisted living facility" under section 198.005.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.115 governing maximum Utilicare payment limits to energy suppliers and direct tenant payment caps.

headings.title: Legislative appropriations to utilicare stabilization fund
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that the utilicare stabilization fund is funded for any fiscal year subject to appropriations by the general assembly.

headings.title: Allocation to low-income weatherization assistance program
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department of social services to coordinate with economic development and allocate appropriated funds to weatherization assistance.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.135 covering legislative funding of the utilicare stabilization fund and weatherization allocations.

headings.title: Creation of Utilicare Stabilization Fund and revenue sources
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Utilicare Stabilization Fund in the state treasury and identifies federal, state, and investment earning revenue sources.

headings.title: Fund nonlapse conditions and general revenue transfers
headings.reviewNote: Restricts transfer of unexpended balances to general revenue until biennial balances exceed two times annual appropriations.

headings.title: Holding period and disposition of rate refund transfers
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that moneys transferred from utility rate refunds under section 470.270 be held for one year for heating and cooling assistance before reverting.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.136 establishing the Utilicare Stabilization Fund, revenue sources, nonlapse rules, and rate refund transfers.

headings.title: Authority to designate economy rate telephone service
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the public service commission to designate classes of economy rate telephone service for eligible subscribers.

headings.title: Rate determination standards and affordability criteria
headings.reviewNote: Requires rates to be determined per local exchange company to enhance affordability compared to regular residential telephone service.

headings.title: Application acceptance procedures for telephone companies
headings.reviewNote: Requires participating local exchange telecommunications companies to accept applications following commission-approved procedures.

headings.title: Single access line limitation per principal residence
headings.reviewNote: Restricts economy rate subscribers to one basic access line at their reported principal residence in the state.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.141 governing commission rate designation, company procedures, and single-line residence limits.

headings.title: Reduced rates for initial telephone service installation
headings.reviewNote: Requires commission-determined reduced rates for initial installation or connection of economy rate telephone service.

headings.title: Prohibition of change fees and disconnect charges
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits order processing or line change fees when switching to economy service and bars disconnect fees upon losing eligibility, subject to rule exceptions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.143 covering reduced initial installation fees and restrictions on telephone service change charges.

headings.title: Commission rulemaking authority for economy telephone service
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to promulgate implementing rules considering federal telephone assistance programs, effective only if promulgated under section 536.024.

headings.title: State general revenue funding for service discounts
headings.reviewNote: Directs general revenues to fund the subscriber discount and determine the federal interstate subscriber line charge waiver amount.

headings.title: Creation of Economy Rate Telephone Service Fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Economy Rate Telephone Service Fund administered by the commission from general assembly appropriations solely for subsection 4 reimbursements; source footnote notes "Subsection 11" appeared in original rolls before renumbering.

headings.title: Quarterly cost reporting and company reimbursements
headings.reviewNote: Requires participating local exchange companies to report quarterly costs and requires the commission, upon appropriation, to authorize reimbursement from the fund.

headings.title: Nonlapse of fund balance to general revenue
headings.reviewNote: Exempts unexpended balances in the economy rate telephone service fund from lapsing to general revenue at the end of each fiscal year.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.145 covering commission rulemaking, discount funding, fund creation, quarterly reimbursements, and nonlapse.

headings.title: Exemption from state sales and use taxes
headings.reviewNote: Exempts economy rate telephone service from state sales and use tax provisions under chapter 144.

headings.title: Local option for gross receipts tax relief
headings.reviewNote: Permits local political subdivisions to reduce or exempt economy rate telephone service from local gross receipts taxes.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.149 covering state sales tax exemptions and local gross receipts tax options for economy telephone service.

headings.title: Board composition and representative tripartite membership
headings.reviewNote: Requires community action agency boards to consist of twelve to thirty-six members representing elected officials, the poor, and community interests.

headings.title: Governing board policy and financial authority
headings.reviewNote: Empowers governing boards to establish personnel, fiscal, and program policies and approve assistance proposals and disbursements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.372 governing community action agency board membership structure and policy responsibilities.

headings.title: Allocation of federal block grant assistance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes use of federal block grant funds for community action programs allocated based on each agency's relative poverty population.

headings.title: State funding authorization during federal shortfall
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes appropriation of state funds for community action agencies if federal funding is unavailable, limited to statutory allocation formulas.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.374 governing federal block grant distribution formulas and contingent state appropriations.

headings.title: Establishment of State Technical Assistance Team and duties
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the State Technical Assistance Team in social services, details investigative priorities, and grants limited peace officer powers.

headings.title: Interagency expertise and cooperation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the team to call upon the expertise of the attorney general, highway patrol, prosecutors, and state departments.

headings.title: County multidisciplinary teams and member composition
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes counties to establish multidisciplinary teams including prosecutors, investigators, physicians, mental health, and law enforcement personnel.

headings.title: Availability of investigation reports and public records
headings.reviewNote: Specifies public availability of criminal investigation and arrest records under chapter 610 and section 210.150.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.520 covering State Technical Assistance Team creation, interagency resources, county teams, and record access.

headings.title: Development of uniform investigation protocols and training
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department, by January 1, 1991, using approved federal child abuse and neglect grant funds, to develop uniform chapter 210 child sexual abuse investigation protocols and train children's division employees.

headings.title: Protocols for multiple suspects and multiple victims
headings.reviewNote: Mandates the development of specialized investigative protocols tailored to cases involving multiple suspects or multiple victims.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.523 directing uniform child sexual abuse investigation protocols, staff training, and specialized procedures.

headings.title: Establishment of Office of Advocacy and Assistance
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Office of Advocacy and Assistance for Senior Citizens within the office of the lieutenant governor.

headings.title: Coordination with long-term care ombudsman program
headings.reviewNote: Requires the senior citizen advocate to coordinate activities with the long-term care ombudsman on complaints regarding facility residents.

headings.title: Investigation of complaints and grounds for dismissal
headings.reviewNote: Requires the senior citizen advocate to investigate complaints unless outside statutory authority, lacking direct substantive or procedural interest, or trivial, frivolous, vexatious, or not made in good faith.

headings.title: Investigative findings and reports to officials
headings.reviewNote: Requires reporting recommended actions to complainants and agencies, and submitting policy recommendations to the governor and general assembly.

headings.title: Senior citizen information clearinghouse and rights dissemination
headings.reviewNote: Directs the advocate to operate as an information clearinghouse in conjunction with health and senior services to inform seniors of rights and services.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.620 establishing the senior citizen advocacy office, investigative duties, reports, and clearinghouse role.

headings.title: Community outreach, partnerships, and disability accommodation
headings.reviewNote: Directs head start grantees to collaborate with community agencies, recruit volunteers, and develop interagency agreements for children with disabilities.

headings.title: Establishment of health services advisory committees
headings.reviewNote: Requires head start grantees to establish a health services advisory committee and other community advisory bodies.

headings.title: Transition procedures for elementary school entry
headings.reviewNote: Requires grantees to establish and maintain procedures supporting smooth transitions into elementary school, preschool, or child care.

headings.title: Promulgation of local policies and procedures
headings.reviewNote: Permits head start grantees, with policy council or committee concurrence, to promulgate and implement local policies and procedures consistent with federal and state laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.657 governing head start outreach, health advisory committees, educational transitions, and local rules.

headings.title: Citation of Faith-Based Organization Liaison Act
headings.reviewNote: Designates the section as the Faith-Based Organization Liaison Act.

headings.title: Designation of regional faith-based liaisons
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of social services to designate existing regional employees as liaisons to faith-based organizations.

headings.title: Primary functions and duties of liaisons
headings.reviewNote: Outlines liaison duties including communicating community needs, promoting involvement, coordinating state efforts, and providing legal guidance.

headings.title: Prohibition of discrimination against faith-based organizations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits regional liaisons from discriminating against any faith-based organization in carrying out statutory duties.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.750 covering title citation, employee liaison designations, core functions, and nondiscrimination.

headings.title: Creation of Missouri Crime Victims Fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the dedicated Missouri Crime Victims Fund in the state treasury, providing for treasurer custody, disbursement, nonreversion, and investment.

headings.title: Disbursement of victim assistance grants
headings.reviewNote: Directs fund disbursements to jurisdictions and entities eligible under the federal Victims of Crime Act for authorized grant purposes.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 660.845 establishing the Missouri Crime Victims Fund and authorizing federal-aligned victim assistance grants.
